pulse.default_for: listing a wallet's concentrated-liquidity LP positions across chains
GigaDex points-campaign position and EV questions
_meta.pulse.primary_use: First step for any "my LP positions / my liquidity / am I in range / should I re-range" task: list what the wallet actually holds, then price the follow-up analytics.
_meta.pulse.workflow_position: first — free; run before any paid lp_call

description: FREE — enumerate the concentrated-liquidity position NFTs a wallet holds on one chain (ethereum, optimism, bsc, polygon, robinhood, base, arbitrum). Pure local RPC reads of a user-supplied address; nothing signed, nothing paid. Returns token pair, fee tier, tick band and whether liquidity is non-zero per position. For in-range status and analytics, follow up with lp_call position-health.

address.description: Wallet address (0x…) whose positions to list — usually the user's own

chain.description: Chain slug, default robinhood — one of: ethereum, optimism, bsc, polygon, robinhood, base, arbitrum

name: lp_positions
